simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מָזוֹן (H4202) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מָזוֹן (mâzôwn) means food First listed occurrence: 2Chr 11 23.

definitions.full: H4202. mazon מָזוֺן noun masculine food, sustenance (so Talmud, Biblical Aramaic, Syriac) — וּמָזוֺן וָלֶחֶם בָּר Gen 45:23 (Di ' ׳מ rather an Aramaic word; perhaps later gloss for original צֵדָה 45:21 ; 42:25 '); לָרֹב הַמָּזוֺן 2Chr 11:23 . זוֺנָה see זנה .
